site.name: Archi Travel Guide
site.tagline: Every number dated & checked against official sources

facts.sourceQuote: €9.90 bought at a ticket counter or in the operator's app; €16.00 bought on board from the driver. Those figures are higher than the €8.40 and €13.00 we verified on 22 July 2026.
facts.hook: The Florence–Siena bus fare just went up.
facts.figureLabel: one-way at the counter or in the app — up from €8.40
facts.detail: Buy on board from the driver and the same journey costs €16.00. The operator's fare tables changed between our July and August checks.

facts.sourceQuote: After the 09:10 from Firenze Autostazione there is no 131R until 14:10. On Sundays and public holidays there are only eight departures all day and the last leaves at 19:10. Summer timetable valid from 27 July 2026.
facts.hook: Planning a Sunday day trip to Siena?
facts.figureLabel: after this bus, nothing to Siena until 14:10
facts.detail: Only eight 131R departures back on Sundays — the last leaves Siena at 19:10, against 20:45 on weekdays.

facts.sourceQuote: The 131R bus stops beside Siena's old town at Via Tozzi/Piazza Gramsci, while the railway station sits about 2 km below the hill.
facts.hook: Bus and train don't arrive in the same Siena.
facts.figureLabel: the railway station sits this far below the hilltop old town
facts.detail: The 131R bus stops beside the centre at Via Tozzi / Piazza Gramsci. For a Piazza del Campo day trip, that decides it.

facts.sourceQuote: Il Campino, along Viale Vittorio Veneto directly below the Fortezza Medicea, is the most used free area in Siena. About a ten-minute walk to Piazza del Campo. Central car parks (Il Campo, Il Duomo, Santa Caterina, San Francesco): €35 continuous daily rate. Rates checked against Si.Ge.Ri.Co. and Visit Siena on 22 July 2026.
facts.hook: Parking in Siena: €0 or €35 a day.
facts.figureLabel: daily rate at the central car parks
facts.detail: Il Campino, below the Fortezza Medicea, is free — about ten minutes' walk to Piazza del Campo. Free spaces fill early in high season.

facts.sourceQuote: The cheapest reliable route is the tram plus the 131R bus, and it costs about €11.90 if you buy both tickets at machines or online rather than from a driver — both fares checked 3 August 2026.
facts.hook: Florence Airport to Siena, without a taxi.
facts.figureLabel: tram T2 into Florence (€2.00) + 131R bus to Siena (€9.90)
facts.detail: The cheapest reliable route. Buy at machines or online — from the driver, the bus leg alone is €16.00.

facts.sourceQuote: Tourist tax of €2.00 per person per night in a B&B, apartment or short let, or €1.00 in a hostel or campsite. Figures published by the Comune di Siena. Checked on 23 July 2026.
facts.hook: Siena's tourist tax, in one line.
facts.figureLabel: per person, per night — B&Bs, apartments and short lets
facts.detail: €1.00 in hostels and campsites. Set by the Comune di Siena, on top of the displayed room price.

facts.sourceQuote: The official Museo Civico page states that tickets including the tower are not reservable. Tickets that include the tower are sold for the same day; places are limited. Morning offers the best chance of securing a same-day place. FACT CHECKED: 11 July 2026.
facts.hook: You cannot book Torre del Mangia in advance.
facts.figureLabel: tower tickets are sold on the day only — not reservable
facts.detail: Places are limited and the tower can close in bad weather. Morning offers the best chance of a slot.
